other_failure_modes.name: Flawed ensemble weight normalization
other_failure_modes.description: The agent optimizes ensemble weights without a sum-to-1 constraint, but then forcefully normalizes the resulting optimal weights to sum to 1 after optimization. This arbitrary rescaling breaks the calibration of the predictions, invalidates the optimized loss, and can severely degrade the final metric.

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold CV pipeline with LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost, but introduces two significant flaws. First, it leaks test set distributions into the training data by computing frequency encodings and group aggregations on the concatenated dataset. Second, the ensemble weight optimization is fundamentally broken because it normalizes the weights to sum to 1 *after* an unconstrained optimization, arbitrarily rescaling the predictions and likely harming the RMSE.
